svg.title: Two cross-sections of the wafer, one above the other. Before the step a thin oxide covers two active areas, an oxide-filled trench between them with a wide stack on it, and a narrow capped gate on the right. After it a thick dotted glass buries everything; its top is higher over the wide stack and the gate than over the active areas.

svg.text: After: a thick glass buries everything
Not to scale. Thin films are drawn thicker than they are.
